blocks.title: KYC Management System — reference flow in production
blocks.note: Each stage passes its output forward under a typed contract — schema, owner and freshness agreed in advance; the audit path shares the timeline with the data path.

blocks.x: Under the hood the pattern is a composition, not a monolith: 4 tower services, the KYC Management System platform for rails, and your estate at core systems for truth. Every boundary is a contract; every contract has an SLO and an owner.

items: Diagnose (2-4 weeks)
Baseline measured and signed, the metric and owner named, the risk envelope agreed in writing.
Prove (6-10 weeks)
The pilot runs on real data with a control group — the gate review happens whether the news is good or not.
Industrialize (1-3 quarters)
Hardening, enablement and scale-out in that order — no rollout faster than the evidence.
Compound (ongoing)
The next decisions enter the same loop — the backlog ranked by measured value per week of effort.

blocks.x: We record the operator's story at handover, not at kickoff — it is the test of whether the system was industrialized or merely installed.
KYC Management System — Industry Use Cases integrates through contracts, not through point-to-point goodwill — each connection has a schema, an owner and a failure policy agreed before it goes live.
